name: dt-app-mcp

tools.name: list_strato_components
tools.description: List Strato components by name or keyword. This tool supports one search term per call. If a multi-word query returns no results, retry with one term at a time. Returns matching components with basic information. Use get_strato_component for detailed component docs.

query.description: Component name or keywords to fuzzy-match (default: "*" returns all)

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

tools.name: get_strato_component
tools.description: Get detailed documentation for a specific Strato component, including props, TypeScript types, code examples, import statements, and - when available - usage guidelines (when/why to use, variants) and accessibility guidelines (roles, ARIA, keyboard). Call list_strato_components first to find the exact component name. Props are returned as a tabular array: props_schema defines the column order [name, type, req, def, desc] and each row in props follows that schema (req is 1 when required, null otherwise; def and desc are null when absent). Usage/accessibility guidance is returned in the usage and accessibility fields; toggle with include_usage and include_accessibility (both default true).

include_examples.description: Include code examples in the response

include_usage.description: Include the component usage guidelines (when to use, variants, content guidelines) when available

include_accessibility.description: Include the component accessibility guidelines (roles, ARIA, keyboard interaction) when available

tools.name: get_strato_usecases
tools.description: Get full code for Strato component use cases. Returns full code without prop tables. Pass only use case names from a preceding get_strato_component result, and request only the 1-2 use cases relevant to the task, not every listed one.

usecases.description: Array of usecase names to retrieve

tools.name: get_sdk
tools.description: Get complete documentation for a specific SDK package. Returns the full SDK documentation including API reference, methods, parameters, return types, and usage examples. Use this to learn about SDK capabilities and how to use specific SDK functions.

tools.name: list_sdks
tools.description: List available Dynatrace SDK documentation packages. Returns a summary of each SDK including title, description, version, and base URL. Use this to discover available SDKs before using get_sdk.

query.description: SDK name or search keywords (default: "*" returns all)

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

tools.name: get_dql_knowledgebase
tools.description: Get Semantic search over the DQL knowledge base for syntax, functions, examples, and best practices. Use this tool to find relevant DQL documentation and code samples before writing or generating any DQL query.

query.description: Natural language search query for DQL documentation

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 3, max 5)

tools.name: get_experience_standard
tools.description: Get app experience standards and Strato design guidance (design patterns and foundations) by keywords. Returns full content for the single best match only, not a list of alternatives. A second call with overlapping keywords will return the same or an equivalent match, so do not repeat the call for a topic already looked up. Possible keywords include: app, header, logo, help, menu, settings, navigation, tabs, datatable, datatablev2, table, rows, columns, interactive, sorting, linewrap, permissions, missing, access, denied, emptystate, modal, tooltip, codesnippet, compliance, checklist, scenario, import, strato. Design patterns/foundations: filtering, status, health, forms, validation, loading, saving, error messages, app structure, app naming, common actions, ai presence, layout, spacing, typography, color, accessibility, interaction states, content checklist, guided interaction.

keywords.description: Array of keywords used to find matching standards or design guidance (e.g., ["app", "header"], ["datatable", "compliance"], ["filtering"], ["status", "health"], ["layout"]). Common keywords: app, header, logo, help, menu, settings, navigation, tabs, datatable, datatablev2, table, rows, columns, interactive, sorting, linewrap, permissions, missing, access, denied, emptystate, modal, tooltip, codesnippet, compliance, checklist, scenario, import, strato. Design patterns/foundations keywords: filtering, status, health, forms, validation, loading, saving, error, messages, app, structure, naming, common, actions, ai, presence, layout, spacing, typography, color, accessibility, interaction, states, content, guided.
